notes: Standalone Li-ion cells / batteries. Special Provision 188 covers ≤ 100 Wh; PI 965 governs air. Common consumer electronics.

properShippingName: Lithium ion batteries contained in equipment
notes: Li-ion INSIDE the device (phones, laptops). PI 967. Ships as ORM-D by many carriers when limits met.
Non-rechargeable Li metal (button cells, some watches). PI 968. Air restrictions tighter than Li-ion.

properShippingName: Lithium metal batteries contained in equipment
notes: Li metal INSIDE the device. PI 970. Includes hearing aids, calculators.
Aerosol cans — flammable propellant. Non-flammable variants ship under 2.2. Common in cosmetics, cleaning.
Generic flammable liquid — needs the technical name in parentheses (e.g. 'contains xylene'). Common shipping industrial solvents.
Perfumes, colognes, essential oils with flammable solvents. Widely shipped B2C — check LQ limits.
Marine pollutants and other environmentally hazardous liquids. Often paired with a class 3 or 6.1 label.
Solid form of UN3082 — includes some chemicals, powders.
Lead-acid car batteries. Corrosive. Freight-only for most carriers.
NiCd / NiMH industrial. Corrosive alkali electrolyte.
Sealed lead-acid (SLA), gel batteries. Excepted from many DG rules when leak-tested.
Elemental mercury and mercury-containing devices. Air-restricted.
Category A pathogens. Special packaging + notification requirements. Not for general commerce.
Category B (lower-risk) biological samples. Ships as UN3373 with triple packaging. Common lab courier.
Ethanol > 24% ABV. Distilleries, hand sanitizer B2B.
Isopropyl alcohol. Cleaning products, medical wipes bulk.
Solvent-based paint / thinner / varnish. Includes lacquers, enamels.
Flammable inks + related materials. Printing supply shipments.
Methanol / methyl alcohol. Also a 6.1 toxin — dual placarding may apply.
LPG, propane, butane cylinders. Ground-only for most consumer carriers.
Refined propane. Camping cylinders, torch fuel.
Compressed gas, non-flammable. Common in commercial replenishment shipments.
Toxic gas. Freight-only, restricted lanes.
Machines containing small quantities of DG (e.g. fuel-line traces in generators).
